extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology; source supports membrane-mimetic conformational context and phenotype-level killing, not a direct pore/permeabilization assay in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RiLK1 changes conformation in SDS membrane-mimetic conditions and retains a beta-structure-rich profile over time; this is mechanism context for membrane interaction, not direct proof of pore formation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD and fluorescence are membrane-mimetic biophysical assays; no direct live-cell membrane permeabilization assay is reported locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RiLK1 has source-supported bactericidal and fungicidal phenotypes, but the paper does not identify a molecular target or direct antimicrobial killing mechanism beyond membrane-interaction context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity endpoints are IC50, MBC, MFC, survival/plating, and colony-count outcomes rather than target-binding or permeabilization measurements.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Covalent immobilization of RiLK1 on polypropylene supports an applied antimicrobial-packaging surface claim; it should not be converted into a molecular mechanism claim against microbes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Packaging data are surface immobilization, release, and mozzarella microbial-count assays, not direct peptide target-mechanism assays.
